summary: Frontend-only testing of Verify page and Note Search — all requested scenarios PASS. (1) Landing nav-verify link navigates to /verify. (2) verify-submit-btn disabled when < 6 chars (verified with 'SA-ED'). (3) Code 'SA-EDU-642310' returns verify-result with 'Approval Test Pro', verify-verified-badge present, verify-approved-row 'Yes', verify-credentials-row 'Yes', verify-active-row 'Active'. (4) 'SA-XXX-000000' → verify-error 'No Professional Alignment Case matches that code. Check the code in your invitation email.' (5) /verify?code=SA-EDU-642310 correctly prefills the input. (6) /join/DMb5FFZqvCFoXaiKPjP2rDHkrPgJNkZ9 renders invitation-verify-link with href='/verify' (no invitation accepted). (7) Login approval.test.pro1@gmail.com/TestPass2026! → /dashboard → /matters. note-search-section visible. Single char 'a' shows neither results panel nor empty panel (correctly gated by min 2 chars). 'calendar' → 1 result with <mark> highlight, note-search-open-{nid} link href=/joint/dda358d8-874e-424d-bb4b-ff70df50dbbd. 'zzzzqq' → note-search-empty with quoted term. (8) Regression: dashboard loads correctly, credentials-verified badge visible in header, /matters list renders.
critical_code_review_comments: NoteSearch.jsx highlight() regex escape has a minor bug: the character class '[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]' includes '$' inside a template literal after backtick which is fine, but the pattern doesn't escape '-'. Low risk since '-' outside a character class is literal. OK.

Verify.jsx uppercases input onChange; users pasting lowercase codes with trailing spaces still work due to .trim() on submit, but the Input maxLength=20 could truncate longer legitimate codes silently — consider a helper hint.
NoteSearch has no loading indicator between debounce fire and response — brief moment where stale results linger. Minor UX polish.
seed_data_creation: None (per instructions: did not create/accept invitations, no emails sent, existing 'Session 1' note preserved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verify page (/verify) is public and fully functional. Nav-verify present on Landing. Join page (/join/{token}) shows invitation-verify-link pointing to /verify. NoteSearch on /matters debounces (300ms) with min 2 char threshold; highlight uses <mark> element. All data-testids from the request are present and correctly wired.
